summary: Family-owned independent P&C agency founded in 1925, operating three New Jersey locations (Jamesburg main office, Little Silver, and the Manasquan-based John B. Wright division) with 11-50 employees. Servicing is centralized: the entire Account Management department and all principals sit in the Jamesburg office, while the agency markets 24/7 online and phone service against 9-5 weekday storefront hours. Public reviews are near-perfect (5.0 across ~177 Google reviews) and recent commercial-lines account manager/CSR postings show repeated hiring for document, certificate and policy-change processing work.

facts.fact: The agency was established in 1925 and operates as an independent agency representing multiple insurance companies for personal, business and risk management needs.
The agency now lists three locations: 60 W Railroad Ave, Jamesburg (main), 680 Branch Ave, Little Silver, and the Manasquan-based John B. Wright Agency division.
The Jamesburg office houses the entire Account Management department plus the offices of the agency principals, and is open to the public Monday-Friday 9am-5pm.
The Little Silver office is open to the public by appointment only, following the agency's relocation of that office to 680 Branch Ave.
Published contact details: Jamesburg 732.521.0001, Little Silver 732.747.0041, fax 732.521.4945, hours Mon-Fri 9am-5pm.
BBB-accredited since 12/27/2022 with an A+ rating, zero complaints filed in the last three years, and zero BBB customer reviews; BBB lists two locations and names Harold Soden as Principal.
Trustindex aggregates 177 Google reviews for sodeninsurance.com at a 5.0 average, with 99% five-star and the business replying to 97% of reviews usually within one day.
Yelp shows a 5.0 rating from only 3 reviews, and the Yelp profile is unclaimed.
In March 2021 the agency partnered with John B. Wright Insurance (est. 1961, Manasquan), extending its footprint into Monmouth County and the Jersey Shore and adding marine/marina specialization.
The agency's own hiring copy states it has earned awards including the 2018 NJAA (New Jersey Agents Alliance) Agency of the Year.
LinkedIn lists the company as privately held, founded 1925, headquartered in Jamesburg, NJ, with 11-50 employees.
Quote requests are handled through an embedded third-party web form, with certificate/service requests routed to a CSR24 client portal.
Claims reporting and payments are not centralized: the agency directs clients to roughly 30 separate carrier portals, each with its own claim and payment link.

operations_signals: Two storefronts are serviced on a 9am-5pm weekday schedule by phone and in person, with a fax line still published as a contact channel (https://sodeninsurance.com/contact-us/).
Little Silver is appointment-only, so walk-in and drop-by servicing concentrates at the Jamesburg main office (https://sodeninsurance.com/shrewsbury-office/).

The agency markets '24/7 services online or through our telephone customer service' and says it keeps phone lines open 24 hours, which sits alongside 9-5 published office hours (https://sodeninsurance.com/about-us/).

The entire Account Management department is located in the Jamesburg office, so servicing for all three locations and the John B. Wright brand flows through one central team (https://sodeninsurance.com/jamesburg-office/).
New business intake is either a phone call or one embedded third-party form; there is no visible online rating, bind or self-service quoting path (https://sodeninsurance.com/request-a-quote/).
Certificates and client service requests are deflected to a CSR24 self-service portal rather than handled by email alone (https://sodeninsurance.com/request-a-quote/).

Billing and claim questions require the client or staff to pick the right carrier from a ~30-carrier list of portals, a common source of 'how do I pay / how do I file' contacts (https://sodeninsurance.com/report-a-claim-pay-online/).

Commercial lines job descriptions define the daily workflow as processing policy change requests, issuing certificates and evidence of insurance, verifying contact details on every customer contact and documenting in the agency management system (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270618IND).
hiring_signals: Recent listings: Commercial Lines Account Manager at $60K-$90K and Customer Service Representative / Assistant Account Manager at $50K-$60K, posted for Little Silver, NJ and fully remote; both now show as expired (Glassdoor listing dated Mar 6, 2026) (https://www.glassdoor.com/job-listing/commercial-lines-account-manager-oliver-le-soden-agency-JV_KO0,32_KE33,55.htm?jl=1010021607512).

The same account manager/CSR role has been posted repeatedly across sites (Jamesburg, Little Silver, Monroe Township) with ranges from $30K-$35K up to $50K-$85K, suggesting ongoing turnover or headcount growth in servicing (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270618IND).

Every version requires prior commercial lines insurance CSR/account management experience, i.e. roles that are skill-specific and slow to backfill (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/338418gog).

Roles are in-office, hybrid or fully remote with computer and phone equipment supplied, so part of the servicing team already works outside the offices (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270618IND).

One posting tells staff to document each customer contact in AMS360, while newer postings prefer candidates with Applied Epic experience, hinting at a possible AMS migration (https://dashboard.idealtraits.com/career/oliver-l-e-soden-agency/15664765844ind).

Hiring runs through an IdealTraits careers page with a pre-employment assessment; as of November 2026 that page and aggregators list no open roles (https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/oliver-l-e-soden-agency-corp).

Listed benefits and scheduling (Mon-Fri, evenings off, tuition reimbursement) point to a standard business-hours operation with no evening or weekend service shift (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/338418gog).
review_themes: Scores are exceptionally high: 5.0 average over roughly 177 Google reviews, 99% five-star, with only a couple of 3-4 star ratings in the distribution (https://www.trustindex.io/reviews/sodeninsurance.com).

Praise is person-specific: reviewers name individual account managers and even their phone extensions, crediting clear, plain-language explanations of coverage (https://reviews.birdeye.com/oliver-l-e-soden-agency-inc-470747904).
Several reviews mention being referred by friends or acquaintances, so word-of-mouth drives a meaningful share of new business (https://reviews.birdeye.com/oliver-l-e-soden-agency-inc-470747904).
The agency replies to about 97% of reviews, usually within a day, indicating an active review-response routine (https://www.trustindex.io/reviews/sodeninsurance.com).

No complaint themes surfaced in public sources: BBB shows an A+ rating and zero complaints in three years (https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/jamesburg/profile/insurance-agency/oliver-le-soden-agency-0221-90220164).
Yelp presence is thin and unmanaged - 5.0 from just 3 reviews on an unclaimed profile (https://www.yelp.com/biz/oliver-l-e-soden-agency-jamesburg).
tech_footprint: Website runs WordPress on the Uncode theme with Contact Form 7 plus reCAPTCHA for forms (https://sodeninsurance.com/).
Site embeds a Trustindex widget that republishes Google reviews in a testimonials block, and a UserWay accessibility widget plus a getterms.io cookie-consent banner (https://sodeninsurance.com/).
A third-party chat / help-out button is embedded sitewide with custom brand colors applied in the theme CSS (https://sodeninsurance.com/).
Quote intake is an iframe served from a marketing subdomain (go.sodeninsurance.com), i.e. a separate lead-capture tool from the site's own contact forms (https://sodeninsurance.com/request-a-quote/).
Client self-service portal is hosted at portald23.csr24.com (CSR24), used for certificates and other service requests (https://sodeninsurance.com/request-a-quote/).

Agency management system appears to be AMS360 in an older posting, with newer postings preferring Applied Epic experience (https://dashboard.idealtraits.com/career/oliver-l-e-soden-agency/15664765844ind).
The John B. Wright division site runs live chat, with an on-screen disclaimer that coverage cannot be bound, altered or cancelled via chat (https://johnbwright.com/client-portal).
Content marketing is active and current: blog posts dated through October 2026 covering niche lines such as marine, pickleball facilities and cyber liability (https://sodeninsurance.com/news/).
LinkedIn company page is active with posts through late October 2026 (https://linkedin.com/company/oliver-l.e.-soden-agency).
Hiring and application intake runs on IdealTraits, including an applicant assessment step (https://dashboard.idealtraits.com/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/Nzk3Nw==/careers).
growth_signals: The March 2021 partnership with John B. Wright Insurance added a Manasquan office, marine/marina specialization and a Monmouth County presence (https://sodeninsurance.com/oliver-l-e-soden-agency-partners-with-john-b-wright-insurance).

The Little Silver office was recently relocated to 680 Branch Ave, framed by the agency as a move to keep serving clients as a 'trusted independent insurance resource' (https://sodeninsurance.com/shrewsbury-office/).

Job ads open with 'Oliver L.E. Soden Agency is growing' and describe adding account managers and assistants to a growing commercial book (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270618IND).

Awards cited by the agency include the 2018 NJAA Agency of the Year, and principal Hal Soden Jr. lists InsurPac Young Agent of the Year (2021) and a Big I New Jersey volunteer award (2023) (https://app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270260gog).

The John B. Wright division was named a Top Sponsor of the Year by the Marine Trades Association of New Jersey at its 2026 annual dinner, reflecting continued marine-market investment (https://www.mtanj.org/wp-content/uploads/2026-Annual-Dinner-News-Release.pdf).

Product line expansion: the site adds niche pages such as pickleball facility, boutique gym, nonprofit, janitorial, HVAC/electrician/plumbing contractor and cyber liability coverage (https://sodeninsurance.com/page-sitemap1.xml).
Publishing cadence is steady (blog items in Sept-Oct 2026), which usually accompanies lead-generation investment rather than a shrinking book (https://sodeninsurance.com/news/).
decision_maker: Hal Soden, Sr. — Principal, listed on the agency's own Jamesburg office page (which also lists principals Bob Soden, Sr. and Bob Soden, Jr.); BBB's business profile additionally names Harold Soden as Principal — https://sodeninsurance.com/jamesburg-office/

inferences.inference: Servicing is bottlenecked in one small central account management team that must cover three offices, two brands and remote staff.
inferences.reasoning: The agency's own office page says the entire Account Management department sits in Jamesburg, while job ads describe account managers doing policy changes, certificates, contact verification and documentation for a multi-location agency. Any intake, certificate or policy-change volume therefore queues in one place.

inferences.inference: After-hours demand is probably answered by voicemail or an outside service rather than by agency staff, creating a gap between the marketed 24/7 promise and 9-5 staffing.
inferences.reasoning: Both the home page and About page claim 24-hour phone lines and 24/7 online service, yet published hours are Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, and job ads advertise 'evenings off' with no evening shifts. No after-hours answering partner is named publicly.

inferences.inference: The agency may be mid-migration between agency management systems (AMS360 to Applied Epic).
inferences.reasoning: An older posting makes documenting in AMS360 a core duty, while the most recent postings list Applied Epic experience as a preference. This is unconfirmed - both products are Applied Systems tools and no migration is announced publicly.

inferences.inference: A large share of inbound contact volume is repetitive 'where do I pay / how do I report a claim / can I get a certificate' traffic that could be deflected.
inferences.reasoning: Clients must choose among ~30 carrier claim-and-pay portals, certificates are handled through a separate CSR24 portal, and quoting starts from a single web form. These are the classic high-volume, low-complexity requests.

inferences.inference: Commercial quoting and renewal prep is manual and information-hungry, making submission intake the highest-value automation target.
inferences.reasoning: Job descriptions cite 'developing insurance quotes, shopping renewals and issuing insurance documentation', and there is no online rater or client data-collection portal for commercial lines on the site.

inferences.inference: Review management is already disciplined, so incremental AI value there is modest compared with intake and servicing.
inferences.reasoning: The agency replies to ~97% of reviews within about a day and holds a 5.0 average across ~177 reviews; the volume is small enough that a person can keep up.

inferences.inference: The Little Silver appointment-only model and remote account managers mean clients increasingly interact digitally, raising the value of a reliable automated front door (web, chat, email).
inferences.reasoning: One office is appointment-only, job ads state employees can work remotely anywhere in the US, and the site already runs a chat widget plus a separate marketing-subdomain lead form - three uncoordinated intake channels.

data_gaps: Google Business Profile and Indeed company pages returned HTTP 403; Google review counts and ratings had to be taken from aggregators (Trustindex 177, Birdeye 120, two Liberty Mutual agent pages 140 and 108), which disagree.
No open job postings exist as of November 2026; hiring cadence is inferred from expired listings whose exact posting dates are only partly visible (Glassdoor shows Mar 2026 expirations).
Headcount estimates conflict: LinkedIn and IdealTraits say 11-50 employees, ZipRecruiter lists 1-10, and LinkedIn's own employee list shows 4 profiles.
No public figures for revenue, premium volume, number of clients, or a formal org chart beyond the named principals.
Unknown how after-hours calls are handled (answering service, voicemail, carrier direct) - no source names a vendor or process.
No negative review themes could be characterized; public sources showed almost no sub-5-star feedback beyond a single 3-star and single 4-star rating, and Yelp review text was not retrievable.
The John B. Wright (Manasquan) division's hours, staffing and whether it shares the same AMS/CRM with Jamesburg are not publicly stated.
Little Silver staffing levels and any hours beyond 'appointment only' are not published.

The mapper note described two offices; the agency now publicly lists three (Jamesburg, Little Silver, Manasquan), and the Little Silver move from the former Shrewsbury address is only partly documented.
No careers page exists on the agency's own website (only the IdealTraits-hosted careers portal), so internal role definitions and pay bands beyond posted ranges are unavailable.
